常驻通知：实时网速、流量统计和快捷操作: Ongoing notification: live speed, usage and quick actions
需要允许 VPN 连接才能开启 VPN 模式: VPN mode needs permission to set up a VPN connection
要把收到的内容导入到分组「%s」吗？: Import the received content into the group "%s"?
允许 NextBox 发送通知后，连接时通知栏会常驻显示实时网速和今日、本月的流: With notifications allowed, NextBox keeps a notification with the live speed and today's and this month's usage while connected. You can also disconnect or switch nodes from it.
连接后可以在这里查看实时连接和日志: Connect to see live connections and the log here
有应用联网时会显示在这里: Connections appear here when apps use the network
想看到每个连接来自哪个应用，可以在「设置 → 性能」里打开「显示连接所属应用」。: To see which app owns each connection, turn on "Show the app of each connection" in Settings → Performance.
这里只显示内核的警告和错误，没有就说明一切正常: Only warnings and errors of the core show up here; none means all is well
全部直连时不需要: Not needed while everything is direct
国内网站和 IP 直连，其余走代理: Chinese sites and IPs direct, the rest through the proxy
所有流量都走代理: All traffic goes through the proxy
到「节点」页导入订阅或分享链接: Import a subscription or share link on the Nodes page
不需要写 tag。保存时名称仍取自表单里的「名称」。: No tag needed. The name still comes from the "Name" field of the form.
表单只列出常用字段，其余字段可以切到 JSON 编辑，两边的修改会互相保留。: The form lists the common fields; edit the rest as JSON. Changes on either side are kept.
正在下载并解析节点，节点多时需要十几秒: Downloading and parsing nodes; many nodes can take a while
这个分组还没有节点: This group has no nodes yet
点右下角「添加」：订阅、扫码、剪贴板或手动添加: Tap "Add" below: subscription, QR code, clipboard or manual
“%s”和其中的 %d 个节点都会被删除。: "%s" and its %d nodes will be deleted.
只有勾选的应用经过 VPN，其他应用直接联网。开启「绕过中国大陆」时，这些应用访: Only the ticked apps go through the VPN; all others connect directly. With "Bypass mainland China" on, these apps also reach Chinese sites directly.
在首页把路由模式切到「指定应用」后，这里勾选的应用才会单独走 VPN。: The apps ticked here only go through the VPN on their own after you switch routing to "Selected apps" on the home page.
没有在图片里找到二维码: No QR code found in the picture
把节点或订阅的二维码放进取景框: Point the camera at a node or subscription QR code
这个节点的分享链接太长，无法生成二维码: This node's share link is too long for a QR code
二维码里包含节点的密码，只分享给信任的人: The QR code contains the node's password; share it only with people you trust
当前是「全部直连」，直连和代理规则暂时不起作用。: Routing is "All direct": direct and proxy rules have no effect for now.
匹配的连接不走代理，直接联网。: Matching connections skip the proxy and connect directly.
匹配的连接始终走代理，即使开启了「绕过中国大陆」。: Matching connections always use the proxy, even with "Bypass mainland China" on.
匹配的连接会被拦截，例如广告或不想让应用访问的地址。: Matching connections are blocked, e.g. ads or addresses apps should not reach.
这类规则需要下载规则集，第一次连接时会自动下载。: This kind of rule needs a rule-set, downloaded automatically on the first connection.
接管全部应用（或下方选中的应用）: Handles all apps (or the apps selected below)
只开启本地代理端口 %d，需要应用自己设置代理: Only opens the local proxy port %d; apps must be set to use it
全局代理和指定应用都遵守：国内网站和 IP 直连: Applies to Global and Selected apps: Chinese sites and IPs connect directly
路由模式为「指定应用」时，只有这些应用走 VPN: With routing set to "Selected apps", only these apps use the VPN
指定哪些网站或应用直连、走代理或屏蔽: Choose sites or apps that go direct, use the proxy or are blocked
为 VPN 分配 IPv6 地址并解析 IPv6: Gives the VPN an IPv6 address and resolves IPv6
打开 App 时和连接期间检查，超过这个时间就更新: Checked when the app opens and while connected; older subscriptions are updated
通知里显示上传 / 下载速度: Shows upload / download speed in the notification
本次、今日和本月用量: Session, today's and this month's usage
「本月」用量从这一天开始计算: The monthly usage starts on this day
开启后才能在通知栏看到网速和流量: Turn them on to see speed and usage in the notification
TCP 测试只测到服务器的握手时间，更快但不代表节点可用。Hysteria2、T: The TCP test only times the handshake with the server: faster, but it does not prove the node works. UDP protocols such as Hysteria2 and TUIC still use the URL test.
通过节点实际访问测试地址，结果最接近真实体验。: Requests the test URL through the node; closest to what you will actually get.
URL 测试访问的地址: The address the URL test requests
超过这个时间算作失败: Longer than this counts as failed
代理的域名立即返回虚拟地址，省去一次经代理的 DNS 查询，打开网页更快: Proxied domains get a virtual address at once, saving a DNS round trip through the proxy; pages open faster
显示连接所属应用: Show the app of each connection
「活动」页显示每个连接是哪个应用发起的，每个连接都要多查询一次，略增耗电: The Activity page shows which app opened each connection; costs one extra lookup per connection
国内域名和直连流量使用: Used for Chinese domains and direct traffic
HTTP + SOCKS5 混合端口，仅代理模式或允许局域网连接时开启: HTTP + SOCKS5 mixed port; open in proxy-only mode or when LAN connections are allowed
局域网内其他设备可以使用这台手机的代理端口: Other devices on the LAN may use this phone's proxy port
重新下载当前需要的规则集: Downloads the rule-sets in use again
导航栏、按钮和弹窗的模糊与折射；省电模式下自动关闭: Blur and refraction on the navigation bar, buttons and dialogs; off automatically in power saving mode
节点、订阅和设置，可以设置密码加密: Nodes, subscriptions and settings; can be encrypted with a password
也可以直接选择 Windows 版的 profiles.json: The desktop app's profiles.json works too
基于 NekoBox / sing-box 的代理客户端: A proxy client based on NekoBox / sing-box
没有可以打开链接的应用: No app can open the link
与 GitHub Releases 上的最新版本比对: Compares with the latest version on GitHub Releases
打开 App 时检查，有新版本会提醒: Checks when the app opens and tells you about a new version
GPL-3.0 开源，欢迎反馈问题: Open source under GPL-3.0; feedback is welcome
密码不对，或者文件已损坏: Wrong password, or the file is damaged
备份里有节点密码和订阅地址。设置密码后文件会被加密，恢复时需要输入；留空则不加密: A backup contains node passwords and subscription URLs. With a password the file is encrypted and needs it to restore; leave empty for no encryption.
连接后，这里会显示每个节点用了多少流量: After connecting, this shows how much traffic each node used
统计的是经过 NextBox 的流量。节点用量只计算实际走代理的部分，直连的流量: Counts traffic that passes through NextBox. A node's usage only includes what actually went through the proxy; direct traffic is not counted towards it.
每日统计和所有节点的流量记录都会清零。: The daily statistics and the traffic counters of all nodes are reset.
当前设置不需要规则集: The current settings need no rule-sets
